notes.title: Weekly Winter Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

This Winter I will give you all Weekly game updates every Wednesday!  This game has grown so much and I want to thank all the players that were with me in the beginning since 2019 as I've learned so much from my coding journey!  You guys are the reason I continue to develop Simulator Z and expand my knowledge in the coding world! 

This upcoming Weekly update will be a new human unit added to the arsenal as well as more improvements to the Thrive mode!
Also I will be adding the ability to change from windowed/windowed borderless/fullscreen

Thank you again survivors for being apart of this family.

GGS
